name: Ghostship
description:
Ghostship is an enhanced native PC port of Super Mario 64, forked from the sm64ex project. Statically compiling the decompiled N64 source code into a native executable, it provides modern graphics and unlocked performance on PC.

Features:
- Native 60 FPS and uncapped framerate rendering without emulation lag
- True widescreen and ultrawide support with customizable camera controls
- Modern analog controller, keyboard, and mouse control schemes
- Support for community texture packs, model replacements, and custom patches
- Requires an authentic Super Mario 64 ROM for asset extraction
